senses.gloss:
mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Desirous of life.
E.
जीव to live, desiderative form, उ aff.

mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्)
Wishing or striving to overcome, emulous, ambitious, a warrior.
E.
जि to conquer, desiderative form, -शतृ aff.

mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु)
Wishing or seeking to inform.
E.
ज्ञः to know, desiderative form of the causal. उ aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Inquiring, investigating.
E.
ज्ञा to know, desiderative form, शानच् aff.

f. (-सा)
1 Asking, inquiring.
2 Search, investigation.
E.
ज्ञा to know, desider. form, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Asked, inquired, sought.
E.
ज्ञा to know, desid. form, क्त aff.

mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु)
Inquiring, inquisitive.
E.
ज्ञा to know, desid. form, उ aff.
